# PassGate
> PassGate is a passkey (WebAuthn) implementation kit for SaaS teams that want passwordless sign-in: a $49 template pack or a $299 done-for-you install with a 48-hour delivery window. It is implementation help, not a security audit.

- Home: https://passgate.incidental.site/
- Template pack: https://passgate.incidental.site/template
- Checklist sample: https://passgate.incidental.site/samples/CHECKLIST.md
- Languages: en (default), zh-CN, zh-TW, ja, ko, ms, vi, fr, es, de — append ?lang=<code>
- Full text: https://passgate.incidental.site/llms-full.txt
- Sitemap: https://passgate.incidental.site/sitemap.xml
- Publisher: Incidental AI (https://incidental.site/)
